title: Ecclesiastes
summary: Ecclesiastes joins the library: Qohelet's search for what lasts, translated fresh from the Hebrew, with notes on its hardest sayings, the ancient copies that differ, and how Jewish and Christian readers have understood it. A new topic page gathers what the Bible says about the fear of the LORD.

items.text: Added Ecclesiastes: a Plain English Translation of all 12 chapters, with 254 study notes and 38 manuscript differences explained.
New topic page: The fear of the LORD.
Notes in Genesis, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Judges, 1 Samuel, 1 and 2 Kings, Job, Psalms, Proverbs and 1 Enoch that quote Ecclesiastes now use its new translation.
